cd /tmp/recon && grep -c unexpected log.txt; grep -c "transport" log.txt; grep "^page" log.txt | tail -2; cat > /tmp/recon/compute.py <<'EOF'
import json
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from collections import defaultdict

raw = json.load(open("/tmp/recon/raw.json"))
customers = raw["customers"]
START = datetime(2025, 3, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
END = datetime(2025, 6, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc)  # exclusive

seen = {}
listings = 0
dup_conflicts = 0
statuses = defaultdict(int)
for p in raw["pages"]:
    for o in p["items"]:
        listings += 1
        if o["id"] in seen:
            if seen[o["id"]] != o:
                dup_conflicts += 1
            continue
        seen[o["id"]] = o

duplicates_skipped = listings - len(seen)
total = 0
count = 0
by_region = {"north": 0, "south": 0, "east": 0, "west": 0}
offsets = defaultdict(int)
missing_customers = set()
for o in seen.values():
    statuses[o["status"]] += 1
    ts = datetime.fromisoformat(o["placed_at"])
    if ts.tzinfo is None:
        raise SystemExit(f"naive timestamp {o}")
    offsets[o["placed_at"][-6:] if "+" in o["placed_at"][10:] or "-" in o["placed_at"][10:] else o["placed_at"][-1]] += 1
    ts = ts.astimezone(timezone.utc)
    if o["status"] != "shipped":
        continue
    if not (START <= ts < END):
        continue
    c = customers.get(o["customer_id"])
    if c is None:
        missing_customers.add(o["customer_id"])
        continue
    pct = c["discount_pct"]
    num = o["amount_cents"] * (100 - pct)
    q, r = divmod(num, 100)
    discounted = q + 1 if r * 2 >= 100 else q  # half up, non-negative values
    total += discounted
    count += 1
    by_region[c["region"]] += discounted

out = {"total_cents": total, "order_count": count,
       "duplicates_skipped": duplicates_skipped, "by_region": by_region}
print("listings", listings, "distinct", len(seen), "dup_conflicts", dup_conflicts)
print("statuses", dict(statuses))
print("offset forms", dict(offsets))
print("missing customers", missing_customers)
print("region sum ok", sum(by_region.values()) == total)
print(json.dumps(out, indent=2))
json.dump(out, open("/tmp/recon/result_candidate.json", "w"), indent=2)
EOF
